patterns.title: Polite requests
patterns.frame: Could I have … / I'd like … / I'll have …

contexts.situation: You are in a café and you are thirsty.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک کافه هستی و تشنه‌ای.
contexts.goal: Ask politely for a glass of water.
contexts.goalPersian: مودبانه یک لیوان آب بخواه.
references: Could I have a glass of water, please?
Can I get a glass of water, please?
I'd like a glass of water, please.
contexts.feedback: 'Could I have …?' is polite because it asks instead of telling.
contexts.feedbackPersian: Could I have …؟ مؤدبانه است چون می‌پرسد، نه دستور می‌دهد.

contexts.situation: You are in a bakery and you want something for breakfast.
contexts.situationPersian: در نانوایی هستی و برای صبحانه چیزی می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Order two croissants.
contexts.goalPersian: دو کروسان سفارش بده.
references: I'll have two croissants, please.
Could I have two croissants, please?
I'd like two croissants, please.
contexts.feedback: 'I'll have …' is the natural way to order when you have decided.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I'll have … روش طبیعی سفارش دادن است وقتی تصمیم گرفته‌ای.

contexts.situation: You are at a hotel reception. Your room is very noisy at night.
contexts.situationPersian: در پذیرش یک هتل هستی. اتاقت شب‌ها خیلی شلوغ و پرسروصداست.
contexts.goal: Ask for a quieter room.
contexts.goalPersian: یک اتاق ساکت‌تر بخواه.
references: Could I have a quieter room, please?
I'd like to move to a quieter room, please.
Can I get a different room? This one is very noisy.
contexts.feedback: With a problem, stay polite: 'Could I have a quieter room?' is better than 'Give me another room.'
contexts.feedbackPersian: وقتی مشکلی هست هم مؤدب بمان: Could I have a quieter room؟ بهتر از Give me another room است.

contexts.situation: You are in a pharmacy. You have had a headache all day.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک داروخانه هستی. از صبح سردرد داری.
contexts.goal: Ask for something for your headache.
contexts.goalPersian: برای سردردت چیزی بخواه.
references: Could I have something for a headache, please?
I'd like some tablets for a headache, please.
Can I get something for my headache?
contexts.feedback: Say what you need after 'Could I have': something for a headache.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از Could I have بگو چه می‌خواهی: چیزی برای سردرد.

contexts.situation: Think of a place you really go to: a shop, an office, a clinic or a school.
contexts.situationPersian: به جایی فکر کن که واقعاً به آن می‌روی: مغازه، اداره، کلینیک یا مدرسه.
contexts.goal: Write a polite request you could really make there.
contexts.goalPersian: درخواستی مودبانه بنویس که واقعاً می‌توانی آنجا بکنی.
references: Could I have an appointment for next week, please?
I'd like to change my seat, please.
contexts.feedback: Use the same pattern for a real request. Add 'please' and one clear detail.
contexts.feedbackPersian: همین الگو را برای یک درخواست واقعی به کار ببر. please و یک جزئیات روشن اضافه کن.

patterns.explanation: Use Could I have …? / I'd like … / I'll have … to ask for things politely. 'I want' is correct but sounds direct. Add 'please' and keep the sentence short.
patterns.explanationPersian: برای درخواست مؤدبانه از Could I have …؟ / I'd like … / I'll have … استفاده کن. «I want» درست است اما تند به نظر می‌رسد. please اضافه کن و جمله را کوتاه نگه دار.
patterns.example: Could I have a glass of water, please?
patterns.examplePersian: می‌توانم یک لیوان آب داشته باشم؟

patterns.title: Asking for help

contexts.situation: You are in class and you do not understand a word.
contexts.situationPersian: در کلاس هستی و معنی یک کلمه را نمی‌فهمی.
contexts.goal: Ask your teacher to help you.
contexts.goalPersian: از معلمت بخواه کمکت کند.
references: Could you explain this word, please?
Can you help me with this word?
Could you say that again, please?
contexts.feedback: A teacher expects a polite request: 'Could you explain this word, please?'
contexts.feedbackPersian: معلم یک درخواست مؤدبانه انتظار دارد: Could you explain this word, please؟

contexts.situation: You are lost in a new city and you need the railway station.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک شهر جدید گم شده‌ای و ایستگاه قطار را می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Ask a stranger to show you the way.
contexts.goalPersian: از یک غریبه بخواه راه را نشانت بدهد.
references: Could you tell me how to get to the station, please?
Can you show me the way to the station?
Excuse me, could you help me? I'm looking for the station.
contexts.feedback: With a stranger, start with 'Excuse me' and then ask: 'Could you tell me …?'
contexts.feedbackPersian: با غریبه با Excuse me شروع کن و بعد بپرس: Could you tell me …؟

contexts.situation: At work your laptop will not connect to the network and you have a meeting soon.
contexts.situationPersian: سر کار لپ‌تاپت به شبکه وصل نمی‌شود و به‌زودی جلسه داری.
contexts.goal: Ask a colleague to help you quickly.
contexts.goalPersian: از همکارت بخواه سریع کمکت کند.
references: Can you help me with my laptop? It won't connect and I have a meeting soon.
Could you take a quick look at my laptop, please?
contexts.feedback: At work, explain the reason in a few words: it makes help easier to give.
contexts.feedbackPersian: در محیط کار دلیل را در چند کلمه بگو؛ کمک کردن را آسان‌تر می‌کند.

contexts.situation: At the airport your suitcase is very heavy and you cannot lift it.
contexts.situationPersian: در فرودگاه چمدانت خیلی سنگین است و نمی‌توانی آن را بلند کنی.
contexts.goal: Ask someone nearby to help you.
contexts.goalPersian: از کسی که نزدیک است بخواه کمکت کند.
references: Could you help me lift this suitcase, please?
Excuse me, can you give me a hand with this suitcase?
contexts.feedback: Ask for a specific action: 'help me lift this suitcase' is clearer than only 'help me'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک کار مشخص بخواه: help me lift this suitcase روشن‌تر از فقط help me است.

contexts.situation: Think of a real task this week where you needed someone's help.
contexts.situationPersian: به کاری واقعی در این هفته فکر کن که به کمک کسی نیاز داشتی.
contexts.goal: Write how you would ask for that help in English.
contexts.goalPersian: بنویس چطور آن کمک را به انگلیسی می‌خواستی.
references: Could you check my CV before Friday, please?
Can you show me how this machine works?
contexts.feedback: Use the same pattern for a real request. Name the task and the time.
contexts.feedbackPersian: همین الگو را برای یک درخواست واقعی به کار ببر. کار و زمان را بگو.

patterns.explanation: Use Can you …? or Could you …? to ask for help; 'Could' is more polite. Use the base verb and add 'please'. With strangers start with 'Excuse me'.
patterns.explanationPersian: برای کمک خواستن از Can you …؟ یا Could you …؟ استفاده کن؛ Could مؤدبانه‌تر است. فعل ساده بیاور و please اضافه کن. با غریبه‌ها با Excuse me شروع کن.
patterns.example: Could you tell me how to get to the station, please?
patterns.examplePersian: می‌توانید بگویید چطور به ایستگاه برسم؟

patterns.title: Asking whether something is available
patterns.titlePersian: پرسیدن اینکه چیزی موجود است یا نه
patterns.frame: Do you have … ? / Is there … ? / Are there … ?

contexts.situation: You are in a small shop and you need milk.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک مغازهٔ کوچک هستی و شیر لازم داری.
contexts.goal: Ask whether the shop has any.
contexts.goalPersian: بپرس آیا مغازه شیر دارد.
references: Do you have any milk?
Is there any milk?
Excuse me, do you sell milk?
contexts.feedback: 'Do you have any milk?' asks about availability. 'Any' fits questions.
contexts.feedbackPersian: Do you have any milk؟ موجود بودن را می‌پرسد. any برای سؤال مناسب است.

contexts.situation: You are in a restaurant and you do not eat meat.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک رستوران هستی و گوشت نمی‌خوری.
contexts.goal: Ask whether there is a vegetarian dish.
contexts.goalPersian: بپرس آیا غذای گیاهی دارند.
references: Is there a vegetarian option?
Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
contexts.feedback: 'Is there a vegetarian option?' is natural when you want to know if one exists.
contexts.feedbackPersian: Is there a vegetarian option؟ وقتی می‌خواهی بدانی وجود دارد یا نه طبیعی است.

contexts.situation: You are checking into a hotel and you need to work online.
contexts.situationPersian: در حال پذیرش در هتل هستی و باید آنلاین کار کنی.
contexts.goal: Ask whether there is Wi-Fi in the rooms.
contexts.goalPersian: بپرس آیا در اتاق‌ها وای‌فای هست.
references: Is there Wi-Fi in the rooms?
Do you have Wi-Fi in the rooms?
contexts.feedback: For one thing use 'Is there …?', for several things 'Are there …?'
contexts.feedbackPersian: برای یک چیز Is there …؟ و برای چند چیز Are there …؟

contexts.situation: You are in a library and you are learning English.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک کتابخانه هستی و انگلیسی یاد می‌گیری.
contexts.goal: Ask whether there are English books for beginners.
contexts.goalPersian: بپرس آیا کتاب انگلیسی برای مبتدی‌ها هست.
references: Are there any English books for beginners?
Do you have books for beginners?
contexts.feedback: 'Are there any …?' is for plural nouns: English books.
contexts.feedbackPersian: Are there any …؟ برای اسم جمع است: English books.

contexts.situation: Think of something you often look for and cannot always find.
contexts.situationPersian: به چیزی فکر کن که اغلب دنبالش می‌گردی و همیشه پیدایش نمی‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Write the question you would ask a shop assistant or colleague.
contexts.goalPersian: سؤالی بنویس که از فروشنده یا همکارت می‌پرسیدی.
references: Do you have this in a larger size?
Is there a quiet room I can use for a call?
Are there any seats left for tonight?
contexts.feedback: Use the same pattern for a real question. Name the thing you are looking for.
contexts.feedbackPersian: همین الگو را برای یک سؤال واقعی به کار ببر. چیزی را که دنبالش هستی نام ببر.

patterns.explanation: Ask whether something is available with Do you have …? or Is there … / Are there …? Use 'any' in questions with plural or uncountable nouns.
patterns.explanationPersian: برای پرسیدن موجود بودن چیزی از Do you have …؟ یا Is there … / Are there …؟ استفاده کن. در سؤال با اسم جمع یا غیرقابل‌شمارش از any استفاده کن.
patterns.example: Do you have any vegetarian dishes?

patterns.title: Asking about price, amount and time
patterns.frame: How much … ? / How many … ? / How long … ?

contexts.situation: You are at a market and you like some apples.
contexts.situationPersian: در بازار هستی و سیب‌ها را دوست داری.
contexts.goal: Ask for the price.
contexts.goalPersian: قیمت را بپرس.
references: How much are these apples?
How much is a kilo of apples?
contexts.feedback: Price → 'How much'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: قیمت ← How much.

contexts.situation: You are in a taxi going to the airport.
contexts.situationPersian: در تاکسی هستی و به فرودگاه می‌روی.
contexts.goal: Ask the driver about the travel time.
contexts.goalPersian: از راننده دربارهٔ مدت سفر بپرس.
references: How long does it take to get to the airport?
How long will the trip take?
contexts.feedback: Time → 'How long does it take …?'
contexts.feedbackPersian: مدت زمان ← How long does it take …؟

contexts.situation: You are visiting a gym and thinking about joining.
contexts.situationPersian: از یک باشگاه ورزشی بازدید می‌کنی و به عضویت فکر می‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Ask about the monthly price.
contexts.goalPersian: قیمت ماهانه را بپرس.
references: How much is a monthly membership?
How much does it cost to join for a month?
contexts.feedback: Monthly price → 'How much is …?' or 'How much does it cost …?'
contexts.feedbackPersian: قیمت ماهانه ← How much is …؟ یا How much does it cost …؟

contexts.situation: You are interested in an English course and you want a small group.
contexts.situationPersian: به یک دورهٔ انگلیسی علاقه داری و گروه کوچک می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Find out the size of a class.
contexts.goalPersian: بپرس هر کلاس چند نفر است.
references: How many students are there in a class?
How many people are in each group?
contexts.feedback: People you can count → 'How many'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: چیزهایی که می‌شود شمرد ← How many.

contexts.situation: Think of a decision you are making now: a trip, a purchase or a course.
contexts.situationPersian: به تصمیمی فکر کن که الان می‌گیری: سفر، خرید یا یک دوره.
contexts.goal: Write two questions about price, amount or time that you would really ask.
contexts.goalPersian: دو سؤال دربارهٔ قیمت، تعداد یا زمان بنویس که واقعاً می‌پرسیدی.
references: How much does the course cost, and how long does it last?
How many students are there in a class, and how much is the fee?
contexts.feedback: Use the pattern for your own decision: ask about price, number or time.
contexts.feedbackPersian: الگو را برای تصمیم واقعی خودت به کار ببر: دربارهٔ قیمت، تعداد یا زمان بپرس.

patterns.explanation: How much asks about price or an uncountable amount, How many about a countable number, and How long about time: How much is a ticket? How many people are coming? How long does it take?
patterns.explanationPersian: How much برای قیمت یا مقدار غیرقابل‌شمارش، How many برای تعداد، و How long برای مدت زمان: How much is a ticket؟ How many people are coming؟ How long does it take؟
patterns.example: How long does it take to get to the airport?
patterns.examplePersian: رسیدن به فرودگاه چقدر طول می‌کشد؟

patterns.title: Talking about habits
patterns.frame: I usually … / I tend to … / I normally …

contexts.situation: A friend asks what a normal morning looks like for you.
contexts.situationPersian: دوستی می‌پرسد صبح عادی تو چطور است.
contexts.goal: Say what you usually have for breakfast.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو معمولاً صبحانه چه می‌خوری.
references: I usually have bread, cheese and tea for breakfast.
I normally eat something light in the morning.
contexts.feedback: Use 'I usually' + a verb for what happens most days.
contexts.feedbackPersian: برای کاری که بیشتر روزها انجام می‌دهی از I usually + فعل استفاده کن.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks about your weekend plans.
contexts.situationPersian: همکاری دربارهٔ برنامهٔ آخر هفته‌ات می‌پرسد.
contexts.goal: Say what you usually do on Fridays.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو معمولاً جمعه‌ها چه می‌کنی.
references: I usually visit my family on Fridays.
On Fridays I tend to relax at home.
contexts.feedback: 'I tend to' is a softer way to say 'I usually'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I tend to شکل ملایم‌تر I usually است.

contexts.situation: A new teammate asks how you organise your work.
contexts.situationPersian: یک هم‌تیمی جدید می‌پرسد کارهایت را چطور سازمان می‌دهی.
contexts.goal: Explain how you usually start your workday.
contexts.goalPersian: توضیح بده معمولاً روز کاری‌ات را چطور شروع می‌کنی.
references: I usually start by checking my emails and planning my tasks.
I tend to do the hardest work first.
contexts.feedback: Say what you do first and in what order: 'I usually start by …'
contexts.feedbackPersian: بگو اول چه می‌کنی و به چه ترتیب: I usually start by …

contexts.situation: Someone asks how you get to work or school.
contexts.situationPersian: کسی می‌پرسد چطور به سر کار یا مدرسه می‌روی.
contexts.goal: Say how you usually travel and how long it takes.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو معمولاً چطور رفت‌وآمد می‌کنی و چقدر طول می‌کشد.
references: I usually take the bus, and it takes about forty minutes.
I normally walk because it's only ten minutes away.
contexts.feedback: Give the means and the time: 'I usually take the bus, and it takes …'
contexts.feedbackPersian: وسیله و زمان را بگو: I usually take the bus, and it takes …

contexts.situation: Think of a habit you have, or one you want to build.
contexts.situationPersian: به عادتی فکر کن که داری یا می‌خواهی بسازی.
contexts.goal: Describe it in two sentences, using your own real life.
contexts.goalPersian: آن را در دو جمله و از زندگی واقعی خودت توضیح بده.
references: I usually study English for twenty minutes before bed. I tend to forget on busy days.
I normally go for a walk after dinner. On weekends I tend to walk for longer.
contexts.feedback: Use two sentences: one habit and one detail about it.
contexts.feedbackPersian: دو جمله بنویس: یک عادت و یک جزئیات دربارهٔ آن.

patterns.explanation: Use I usually / I normally / I tend to + base verb to talk about routines. 'Usually' goes before the main verb: I usually get up at seven.
patterns.explanationPersian: برای صحبت دربارهٔ روال‌ها از I usually / I normally / I tend to + فعل ساده استفاده کن. usually قبل از فعل اصلی می‌آید: I usually get up at seven.
patterns.example: I usually have bread, cheese and tea for breakfast.
patterns.examplePersian: معمولاً برای صبحانه نان، پنیر و چای می‌خورم.

patterns.title: Saying what you want to find
patterns.titlePersian: گفتن اینکه دنبال چه چیزی هستی
patterns.frame: I'm looking for + what you want
patterns.explanation: Use I'm looking for + noun to say what you want to find or buy. It is more natural than 'I search' and it is polite with shop assistants. You can add details: I'm looking for a cheap hotel near the station.
patterns.explanationPersian: از I'm looking for + اسم استفاده کن تا بگویی دنبال چه چیزی هستی یا چه چیزی می‌خواهی بخری. طبیعی‌تر از I search است و با فروشنده مؤدبانه است. می‌توانی جزئیات اضافه کنی: I'm looking for a cheap hotel near the station.
patterns.example: I'm looking for a black jacket in a size medium.
patterns.examplePersian: دنبال یک کت مشکی با سایز مدیوم می‌گردم.

contexts.situation: You are in a bookshop. You want a dictionary to help you learn English.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک کتاب‌فروشی هستی. برای یادگیری انگلیسی یک فرهنگ لغت می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Tell the assistant what you want.
contexts.goalPersian: به فروشنده بگو چه می‌خواهی.
references: I'm looking for an English-Persian dictionary.
I'm looking for a dictionary, please.
Hi, I'm looking for a good dictionary for learners.
contexts.feedback: 'I'm looking for' + the thing: short and clear.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I'm looking for + چیز مورد نظر: کوتاه و روشن.

contexts.situation: You are in a shoe shop. You want black sports shoes in size forty-two.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک کفش‌فروشی هستی. کفش ورزشی مشکی سایز چهل و دو می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Say exactly what you want.
contexts.goalPersian: دقیقاً بگو چه می‌خواهی.
references: I'm looking for black sports shoes in size 42.
I'm looking for sports shoes. Do you have black ones in 42?
contexts.feedback: Add the details after the noun: colour, type and size.
contexts.feedbackPersian: جزئیات را بعد از اسم اضافه کن: رنگ، نوع و سایز.

contexts.situation: You have just arrived in a city. You need a cheap place to sleep for two nights.
contexts.situationPersian: تازه به یک شهر رسیده‌ای. برای دو شب جای ارزانی برای خوابیدن لازم داری.
contexts.goal: Explain to the receptionist what you need.
contexts.goalPersian: به مسئول پذیرش بگو چه لازم داری.
references: I'm looking for a cheap hotel for two nights.
I'm looking for a cheap room for two nights, please.
contexts.feedback: State the thing, the price level and the time.
contexts.feedbackPersian: چیز، سطح قیمت و مدت را بگو.

contexts.situation: You talk to a recruiter. You want a part-time job in an office, in the afternoons.
contexts.situationPersian: با یک کارجو صحبت می‌کنی. یک کار پاره‌وقت اداری برای بعدازظهرها می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Say what kind of job you want.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو چه نوع شغلی می‌خواهی.
references: I'm looking for a part-time office job.
I'm looking for a part-time job in an office in the afternoons.
contexts.feedback: The same pattern works for jobs, flats and services, not only for things.
contexts.feedbackPersian: همین الگو برای شغل، خانه و خدمات هم کار می‌کند، نه فقط برای اشیا.

contexts.situation: Think of something you are really looking for now: a book, a flat, a course or a gift.
contexts.situationPersian: به چیزی فکر کن که الان واقعاً دنبالش هستی: کتاب، خانه، دوره یا هدیه.
contexts.goal: Write what you would say to a shop assistant or a friend.
contexts.goalPersian: بنویس به فروشنده یا دوستت چه می‌گفتی.
references: I'm looking for an English course in the evenings.
I'm looking for a small flat near my work.
contexts.feedback: Add two details after the noun: size, price, place or time.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از اسم دو جزئیات اضافه کن: اندازه، قیمت، مکان یا زمان.

patterns.title: Saying what is necessary
patterns.frame: I need to + verb / I have to + verb
patterns.explanation: Use I need to + verb for something necessary. It sounds more neutral and polite than 'I must'. Add the reason with because or so: I need to cancel my appointment because I'm ill.
patterns.explanationPersian: برای چیزی که ضروری است از I need to + فعل استفاده کن. از I must بی‌طرف‌تر و مؤدبانه‌تر است. دلیل را با because یا so اضافه کن: I need to cancel my appointment because I'm ill.
patterns.example: I need to cancel my appointment because I'm ill.
patterns.examplePersian: باید وقتم را لغو کنم چون مریضم.

contexts.situation: You are ill and cannot go to your dentist appointment tomorrow.
contexts.situationPersian: مریض هستی و نمی‌توانی فردا به وقت دندان‌پزشکی‌ات بروی.
contexts.goal: Tell the clinic what you must do.
contexts.goalPersian: به کلینیک بگو چه کاری باید بکنی.
references: I need to cancel my appointment for tomorrow.
I need to cancel tomorrow's appointment. I'm ill.
contexts.feedback: 'I need to' + verb states the necessary action. Add a short reason.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I need to + فعل کار ضروری را بیان می‌کند. یک دلیل کوتاه اضافه کن.

contexts.situation: You are in a meeting. Your train leaves at six and the meeting may last until six.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک جلسه هستی. قطار تو ساعت شش حرکت می‌کند و جلسه ممکن است تا شش طول بکشد.
contexts.goal: Tell the group when you have to go.
contexts.goalPersian: به گروه بگو کِی باید بروی.
references: I need to leave at five to catch my train.
I have to leave at five because I have a train to catch.
contexts.feedback: 'I have to' and 'I need to' are both fine. Say the time and the reason.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I have to و I need to هر دو درست‌اند. زمان و دلیل را بگو.

contexts.situation: You have lost your bank card and you are at the bank counter.
contexts.situationPersian: کارت بانکی‌ات را گم کرده‌ای و پشت باجهٔ بانک هستی.
contexts.goal: Explain to the clerk what you must do.
contexts.goalPersian: به کارمند بگو چه کاری باید بکنی.
references: I need to report a lost card.
I need to block my card. I've lost it.
contexts.feedback: State the action first, then explain: 'I need to block my card. I've lost it.'
contexts.feedbackPersian: اول کار را بگو، بعد توضیح بده: I need to block my card. I've lost it.

contexts.situation: You did not understand the homework and the lesson starts in ten minutes.
contexts.situationPersian: تکلیف را نفهمیده‌ای و درس ده دقیقه دیگر شروع می‌شود.
contexts.goal: Tell your teacher that you must ask a question.
contexts.goalPersian: به معلمت بگو باید یک سؤال بپرسی.
references: I need to ask you about the homework.
I need to ask a question about the homework before the lesson.
contexts.feedback: 'I need to ask' is a polite way to start a question that matters.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I need to ask روش مؤدبانهٔ شروع یک سؤال مهم است.

contexts.situation: Think of something you really have to do this week: a task, a visit or a payment.
contexts.situationPersian: به کاری فکر کن که این هفته واقعاً باید انجام بدهی: یک کار، یک دیدار یا یک پرداخت.
contexts.goal: Write what you would say to explain it to someone.
contexts.goalPersian: بنویس برای توضیح دادن آن به کسی چه می‌گفتی.
references: I need to renew my passport this week because it expires next month.
I have to finish my report by Friday.
contexts.feedback: Add the reason or the deadline to make it clear.
contexts.feedbackPersian: دلیل یا موعد را اضافه کن تا روشن شود.

patterns.title: Suggesting a plan
patterns.frame: Why don't we …? / Shall we …? / How about …? / Let's …
patterns.explanation: Use these to suggest an activity for you and other people together. Why don't we / Let's + base verb; How about + noun or -ing; Shall we + base verb?
patterns.explanationPersian: از این‌ها برای پیشنهاد یک فعالیت به خودت و دیگران استفاده کن. Why don't we / Let's + فعل ساده؛ How about + اسم یا -ing؛ Shall we + فعل ساده؟
patterns.example: Why don't we go for a walk?

contexts.situation: It is a sunny Saturday and you and a friend have no plans.
contexts.situationPersian: شنبهٔ آفتابی است و تو و دوستت برنامه‌ای ندارید.
contexts.goal: Suggest doing something outside.
contexts.goalPersian: پیشنهاد کن کاری بیرون انجام دهید.
references: Why don't we go for a walk in the park?
Shall we go for a walk?
Let's go to the park.
How about a walk in the park?
contexts.feedback: All four patterns work. Keep the verb in the base form after 'Why don't we', 'Shall we' and 'Let's'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: هر چهار الگو درست‌اند. بعد از Why don't we، Shall we و Let's فعل ساده بیاور.

contexts.situation: It is lunchtime and a colleague cannot decide where to eat.
contexts.situationPersian: وقت ناهار است و یک همکار نمی‌تواند تصمیم بگیرد کجا بخورد.
contexts.goal: Suggest a place.
contexts.goalPersian: یک مکان پیشنهاد بده.
references: Why don't we try the new Italian place?
How about the Italian restaurant?
Shall we go to the cafe downstairs?
contexts.feedback: 'How about' + a noun is the shortest way to suggest.
contexts.feedbackPersian: How about + اسم کوتاه‌ترین راه پیشنهاد دادن است.

contexts.situation: Your team is behind schedule and nobody knows how to start.
contexts.situationPersian: تیم شما از برنامه عقب است و کسی نمی‌داند از کجا شروع کند.
contexts.goal: Suggest a way to organise the work.
contexts.goalPersian: راهی برای سازماندهی کار پیشنهاد بده.
references: Why don't we split the tasks between us?
Let's make a list of what we have to do.
How about starting with the most urgent task?
contexts.feedback: 'How about' can be followed by -ing: How about starting with …?
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از How about می‌توان -ing آورد: How about starting with …؟

contexts.situation: Two friends are planning a trip but cannot choose a date.
contexts.situationPersian: دو دوست در حال برنامه‌ریزی یک سفرند و نمی‌توانند تاریخی انتخاب کنند.
contexts.goal: Suggest a date that works for you both.
contexts.goalPersian: تاریخی پیشنهاد بده که برای هر دو مناسب باشد.
references: How about the first weekend of May?
Shall we go in May?
Why don't we go in the first week of May?
contexts.feedback: A concrete suggestion (a date) is better than 'when you want'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: پیشنهاد مشخص (یک تاریخ) بهتر از «هر وقت دوست داری» است.

contexts.situation: Think of something you would like to do with a friend or your family soon.
contexts.situationPersian: به کاری فکر کن که می‌خواهی به‌زودی با یک دوست یا خانواده‌ات انجام دهی.
contexts.goal: Write your suggestion in one or two sentences.
contexts.goalPersian: پیشنهادت را در یک یا دو جمله بنویس.
references: Why don't we have dinner at that new restaurant on Friday?
Shall we visit Grandma this weekend? How about Sunday afternoon?
contexts.feedback: Say what and when: it makes the suggestion easy to accept.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بگو چه کاری و کِی: پذیرفتن پیشنهاد را آسان می‌کند.

patterns.title: Talking about plans and hopes
patterns.frame: I'm going to … / I'm planning to … / I'm hoping to …
patterns.explanation: Use these for plans and intentions. Going to = you have already decided; planning to = you are thinking about how; hoping to = you want it but you are not sure. All are followed by the base verb.
patterns.explanationPersian: از این‌ها برای برنامه و قصد استفاده کن. going to = قبلاً تصمیم گرفته‌ای؛ planning to = داری دربارهٔ چگونگی‌اش فکر می‌کنی؛ hoping to = می‌خواهی اما مطمئن نیستی. بعد از همه فعل ساده می‌آید.
patterns.example: I'm planning to learn to drive this year.
patterns.examplePersian: قصد دارم امسال رانندگی یاد بگیرم.

contexts.situation: A friend asks what you will do tomorrow.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌پرسد فردا چه می‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Say one thing you have decided to do.
contexts.goalPersian: یک کاری را بگو که تصمیم گرفته‌ای انجام بدهی.
references: I'm going to visit my parents tomorrow.
I'm going to stay at home and rest.
contexts.feedback: 'I'm going to' + verb: a decision you have already made.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I'm going to + فعل: تصمیمی که قبلاً گرفته‌ای.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks what you will do in your summer holiday.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار می‌پرسد در تعطیلات تابستان چه می‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Say what you are planning.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو چه برنامه‌ای داری.
references: I'm planning to travel to the north for a week.
I'm going to visit some friends in Shiraz.
contexts.feedback: 'Planning to' suggests you are still organising the details.
contexts.feedbackPersian: planning to نشان می‌دهد هنوز جزئیات را سازمان می‌دهی.

contexts.situation: In a job interview you are asked where you want to be next year.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک مصاحبهٔ شغلی می‌پرسند سال بعد کجا می‌خواهی باشی.
contexts.goal: Say something you hope to achieve at work.
contexts.goalPersian: چیزی را بگو که امیدواری در کار به آن برسی.
references: I'm hoping to lead a small team next year.
I'm planning to get a professional certificate.
contexts.feedback: 'Hoping to' is honest about the goal without promising it.
contexts.feedbackPersian: hoping to بدون قول دادن دربارهٔ هدف صادقانه صحبت می‌کند.

contexts.situation: Your English teacher asks how you will practise this month.
contexts.situationPersian: معلم انگلیسی‌ات می‌پرسد این ماه چطور تمرین می‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Say your plan.
contexts.goalPersian: برنامه‌ات را بگو.
references: I'm going to practise speaking every day for ten minutes.
I'm planning to join a conversation club.
contexts.feedback: Make the plan concrete: how often and for how long.
contexts.feedbackPersian: برنامه را مشخص کن: هر چند وقت یک بار و چقدر.

contexts.situation: Think of a real plan or hope you have for the next year.
contexts.situationPersian: به یک برنامه یا امید واقعی برای سال آینده فکر کن.
contexts.goal: Write it in two sentences, one with a plan and one with a hope.
contexts.goalPersian: آن را در دو جمله بنویس: یک جمله برنامه و یک جمله امید.
references: I'm going to change my job in the spring. I'm hoping to find something closer to home.
I'm planning to start a small online course in September. I'm going to study for an hour every evening.
contexts.feedback: Use two different forms to show the difference between plan and hope.
contexts.feedbackPersian: از دو شکل مختلف استفاده کن تا تفاوت برنامه و امید را نشان بدهی.

patterns.title: Giving reasons
patterns.frame: … because … / The reason is that … / That's why …
patterns.explanation: Give a reason with because + clause, or with The reason is that …. Use That's why … for the result: The prices are high. That's why many people leave the city.
patterns.explanationPersian: دلیل را با because + جمله یا The reason is that … بگو. برای نتیجه از That's why … استفاده کن: The prices are high. That's why many people leave the city.
patterns.example: I prefer trains because they are more comfortable.
patterns.examplePersian: قطار را ترجیح می‌دهم چون راحت‌تر است.

contexts.situation: A friend asks why you prefer tea in the morning.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌پرسد چرا صبح‌ها چای را ترجیح می‌دهی.
contexts.goal: Say what you prefer and give a reason.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو چه چیزی را ترجیح می‌دهی و دلیلش را بگو.
references: I prefer tea because it is lighter than coffee.
I prefer tea in the morning because coffee makes me nervous.
contexts.feedback: 'Because' is followed by a full clause: subject + verb.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از because جملهٔ کامل می‌آید: فاعل + فعل.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks why you take the bus instead of driving.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار می‌پرسد چرا به جای رانندگی با اتوبوس می‌روی.
contexts.goal: Explain your reason.
contexts.goalPersian: دلیلت را توضیح بده.
references: The reason is that parking is expensive.
I take the bus because parking is very expensive and the traffic is heavy.
contexts.feedback: 'The reason is that …' is a clear way to introduce one main reason.
contexts.feedbackPersian: The reason is that … راه روشنی برای معرفی دلیل اصلی است.

contexts.situation: You arrived late to a meeting and your manager is waiting for an explanation.
contexts.situationPersian: دیر به جلسه رسیده‌ای و مدیرت منتظر توضیح است.
contexts.goal: Explain the reason briefly and politely.
contexts.goalPersian: دلیل را کوتاه و مؤدبانه توضیح بده.
references: The reason is that my train was delayed.
I'm sorry I'm late. The reason is that the traffic was terrible.
contexts.feedback: Apologise first, then give the reason in one sentence.
contexts.feedbackPersian: اول عذرخواهی کن، بعد دلیل را در یک جمله بگو.

contexts.situation: You explain to a visitor why many people in your city work from home.
contexts.situationPersian: برای یک مهمان توضیح می‌دهی چرا بسیاری از مردم شهرتان در خانه کار می‌کنند.
contexts.goal: Give a reason and a result.
contexts.goalPersian: یک دلیل و یک نتیجه بگو.
references: Travelling is slow and expensive. That's why many people work from home.
Offices are expensive, so that's why more companies allow remote work.
contexts.feedback: The reason comes first; 'That's why' introduces the result.
contexts.feedbackPersian: اول دلیل می‌آید؛ That's why نتیجه را معرفی می‌کند.

contexts.situation: Think of a choice you made recently: a job, a course, a purchase or a trip.
contexts.situationPersian: به انتخابی فکر کن که اخیراً کرده‌ای: شغل، دوره، خرید یا سفر.
contexts.goal: Write what you chose and why.
contexts.goalPersian: بنویس چه چیزی را انتخاب کردی و چرا.
references: I chose this course because the classes are in the evening. The reason is that I work during the day.
I bought a used car because new ones are too expensive.
contexts.feedback: One choice, one clear reason. A second reason with 'also' is a bonus.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک انتخاب، یک دلیل روشن. دلیل دوم با also امتیاز اضافه است.

patterns.title: Saying it depends
patterns.explanation: When the answer is not simple, say what it depends on. Use it depends on + noun, or it depends on whether / how + clause. It is more helpful than just 'maybe'.
patterns.explanationPersian: وقتی جواب ساده نیست بگو به چه چیزی بستگی دارد. از it depends on + اسم یا it depends on whether / how + جمله استفاده کن. از «شاید» تنها مفیدتر است.
patterns.example: Is the course expensive? — It depends on the level.
patterns.examplePersian: دوره گران است؟ — بستگی به سطح دارد.

contexts.situation: A tourist asks you how much a taxi to the airport costs.
contexts.situationPersian: یک گردشگر می‌پرسد تاکسی تا فرودگاه چقدر می‌شود.
contexts.goal: Explain that the price changes and say what it changes with.
contexts.goalPersian: توضیح بده قیمت تغییر می‌کند و بگو به چه چیزی بستگی دارد.
references: It depends on the traffic and the time of day.
It depends on the time. At night it costs more.
contexts.feedback: Say what it depends on: it gives the listener something useful.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بگو به چه چیزی بستگی دارد: به شنونده اطلاعات مفیدی می‌دهد.

contexts.situation: A friend asks if you are free on Saturday for a picnic.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌پرسد شنبه برای پیک‌نیک آزاد هستی یا نه.
contexts.goal: Say that your answer depends on the weather.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو جوابت به آب‌وهوا بستگی دارد.
references: It depends on the weather.
It depends on whether it rains.
contexts.feedback: 'It depends on whether + clause' is useful for yes/no conditions.
contexts.feedbackPersian: it depends on whether + جمله برای شرط‌های بله/خیر مفید است.

contexts.situation: A friend asks if you will accept a new job offer.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌پرسد پیشنهاد کار جدید را می‌پذیری یا نه.
contexts.goal: Say what your decision depends on.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو تصمیمت به چه چیزی بستگی دارد.
references: It depends on the salary and the team.
It depends on how much they pay and where the office is.
contexts.feedback: Give two things it depends on to sound thoughtful.
contexts.feedbackPersian: دو چیز را بگو که به آن بستگی دارد تا سنجیده به نظر برسی.

contexts.situation: A new colleague asks whether the English exam is difficult.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار جدید می‌پرسد آزمون انگلیسی سخت است یا نه.
contexts.goal: Explain that the answer is different for each person, and what it changes with.
contexts.goalPersian: توضیح بده جواب برای هر شخص فرق می‌کند و بگو با چه چیزی فرق می‌کند.
references: It depends on how much you study.
It depends on your level of English.
contexts.feedback: After 'depends on' use a noun or 'how / whether + clause', not an infinitive.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از depends on اسم یا how / whether + جمله بیاور، نه مصدر.

contexts.situation: Think of a real question people often ask you, where the answer is not simple.
contexts.situationPersian: به سؤالی واقعی فکر کن که مردم اغلب از تو می‌پرسند و جوابش ساده نیست.
contexts.goal: Write the question and an honest answer that is not simple.
contexts.goalPersian: سؤال و یک جواب صادقانه بنویس که ساده نیست.
references: Is it easy to find a job in my field? It depends on the city and on your experience.
Is it expensive to live here? It depends on the neighbourhood.
contexts.feedback: Add one example after 'it depends on' to make your answer clear.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از it depends on یک مثال اضافه کن تا جوابت روشن شود.

patterns.title: Talking about the past: used to
patterns.explanation: Used to + base verb describes habits and states in the past that are not true now. It is not for one-time events. It often contrasts with now: I used to smoke, but I stopped.
patterns.explanationPersian: used to + فعل ساده عادت‌ها و وضعیت‌های گذشته‌ای را توصیف می‌کند که الان درست نیستند. برای یک رویداد یک‌باره نیست. اغلب با حال مقایسه می‌شود: I used to smoke, but I stopped.
patterns.example: I used to play football every weekend, but now I don't have time.
patterns.examplePersian: قبلاً هر آخر هفته فوتبال بازی می‌کردم اما الان وقت ندارم.

contexts.situation: A friend asks what you liked doing as a child.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌پرسد وقتی بچه بودی چه کاری را دوست داشتی.
contexts.goal: Say a habit you had in your childhood.
contexts.goalPersian: عادتی را بگو که در بچگی داشتی.
references: I used to play outside with my cousins every afternoon.
I used to collect stamps when I was a child.
contexts.feedback: 'Used to' is for repeated past habits. A single event uses the past simple.
contexts.feedbackPersian: used to برای عادت‌های تکراری گذشته است. رویداد یک‌باره گذشتهٔ ساده می‌گیرد.

contexts.situation: You show an old photo of your street and a visitor is curious.
contexts.situationPersian: یک عکس قدیمی از خیابانتان نشان می‌دهی و مهمان کنجکاو است.
contexts.goal: Say how the place was different in the past.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو آن مکان در گذشته چه فرقی داشت.
references: There used to be a small cinema here.
This street used to be much quieter.
contexts.feedback: 'There used to be' describes things that existed before.
contexts.feedbackPersian: There used to be چیزهایی را توصیف می‌کند که قبلاً وجود داشتند.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks about your previous job.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار دربارهٔ شغل قبلی‌ات می‌پرسد.
contexts.goal: Say something you used to do there and do not do now.
contexts.goalPersian: کاری را بگو که آنجا انجام می‌دادی و الان نمی‌دهی.
references: I used to travel a lot for my old job.
I used to work night shifts.
contexts.feedback: Contrast with the present to make the meaning clear.
contexts.feedbackPersian: با حال مقایسه کن تا معنی روشن شود.

contexts.situation: A friend is surprised that you now cook very well.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست تعجب کرده که حالا خیلی خوب آشپزی می‌کنی.
contexts.goal: Say that you were different before.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو قبلاً فرق داشتی.
references: I used to burn everything, but now I cook every day.
I used to hate cooking, but I learned.
contexts.feedback: 'Used to … but now …' is the natural contrast pattern.
contexts.feedbackPersian: used to … but now … الگوی طبیعی مقایسه است.

contexts.situation: Think of something that was part of your life before and is not any more.
contexts.situationPersian: به چیزی فکر کن که قبلاً بخشی از زندگی‌ات بود و الان نیست.
contexts.goal: Write about it in two sentences.
contexts.goalPersian: دربارهٔ آن در دو جمله بنویس.
references: I used to live near the sea. Now I live in the middle of the country.
I used to read a lot, but I rarely have time now.
contexts.feedback: Use 'used to' for the past and the present simple for how it is now.
contexts.feedbackPersian: برای گذشته از used to و برای وضعیت فعلی از حال ساده استفاده کن.

patterns.title: Giving advice
patterns.frame: You should … / Why don't you …? / If I were you, I'd … / I'd recommend …
patterns.explanation: Give friendly advice with should + base verb, Why don't you + base verb?, If I were you, I'd + base verb, or I'd recommend + -ing. Use were (not was) after If I in advice.
patterns.explanationPersian: با should + فعل ساده، Why don't you + فعل ساده؟، If I were you, I'd + فعل ساده یا I'd recommend + -ing توصیهٔ دوستانه بده. در توصیه بعد از If I از were استفاده کن (نه was).
patterns.example: If I were you, I'd talk to your manager first.
patterns.examplePersian: اگر جای تو بودم، اول با مدیرت صحبت می‌کردم.

contexts.situation: A friend says they cannot sleep well at night.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌گوید شب‌ها خوب نمی‌خوابد.
contexts.goal: Give one piece of advice.
contexts.goalPersian: یک توصیه بده.
references: You should go to bed earlier.
Why don't you stop drinking coffee after lunch?
If I were you, I'd turn off my phone before bed.
contexts.feedback: Choose a gentle pattern: 'You should …' is direct, 'Why don't you …?' is softer.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک الگوی ملایم انتخاب کن: You should … مستقیم است و Why don't you …؟ نرم‌تر.

contexts.situation: A colleague wants to improve their English quickly.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار می‌خواهد انگلیسی‌اش را سریع بهتر کند.
contexts.goal: Recommend something that could help.
contexts.goalPersian: چیزی را که ممکن است کمک کند پیشنهاد بده.
references: I'd recommend watching short videos every day.
You should join a conversation club.
contexts.feedback: After 'I'd recommend' use the -ing form.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از I'd recommend شکل -ing می‌آید.

contexts.situation: A friend has a job interview tomorrow and is very nervous.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست فردا مصاحبهٔ شغلی دارد و خیلی استرس دارد.
contexts.goal: Give two pieces of advice.
contexts.goalPersian: دو توصیه بده.
references: You should prepare answers for common questions.
If I were you, I'd arrive fifteen minutes early.
Why don't you practise with a friend?
contexts.feedback: Two different patterns make the advice natural, not repetitive.
contexts.feedbackPersian: دو الگوی متفاوت توصیه را طبیعی و غیرتکراری می‌کند.

contexts.situation: A friend spends too much money on food delivery.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست خیلی زیاد برای سفارش غذا خرج می‌کند.
contexts.goal: Advise them gently.
contexts.goalPersian: به نرمی به او توصیه کن.
references: Why don't you cook at home twice a week?
If I were you, I'd set a monthly budget for food.
contexts.feedback: With a sensitive topic, a question like 'Why don't you …?' sounds kinder.
contexts.feedbackPersian: در موضوع حساس، سؤالی مثل Why don't you …؟ مهربان‌تر به نظر می‌رسد.

contexts.situation: Think of a person you know who has a real problem or goal.
contexts.situationPersian: به کسی فکر کن که مشکل یا هدفی واقعی دارد.
contexts.goal: Write the advice you would give.
contexts.goalPersian: توصیه‌ای را بنویس که به او می‌دادی.
references: If I were you, I'd ask for feedback every month. You should also write down your goals.
I'd recommend starting with a small goal. Why don't you try for two weeks first?
contexts.feedback: Give one clear action and, if you can, one reason.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک کار روشن و در صورت امکان یک دلیل بگو.

patterns.title: Asking very politely
patterns.frame: Would you mind + -ing …? / Would you mind if I + past …?
patterns.explanation: A very polite way to ask someone to do something or to ask permission. Use -ing after 'mind': Would you mind closing the door? For permission: Would you mind if I opened the window? The polite answer 'no problem' is 'Not at all.'
patterns.explanationPersian: روشی بسیار مؤدبانه برای درخواست یا اجازه گرفتن. بعد از mind شکل -ing می‌آید: Would you mind closing the door؟ برای اجازه: Would you mind if I opened the window؟ جواب مؤدبانهٔ «مشکلی نیست» می‌شود Not at all.
patterns.example: Would you mind sending me the file before lunch?
patterns.examplePersian: ممکن است قبل از ناهار فایل را برایم بفرستید؟

contexts.situation: You are in an office. A colleague is standing next to the printer.
contexts.situationPersian: در یک دفتر هستی. یک همکار کنار چاپگر ایستاده است.
contexts.goal: Ask them politely to print one page for you.
contexts.goalPersian: مؤدبانه از او بخواه یک صفحه برایت چاپ کند.
references: Would you mind printing this page for me?
Would you mind printing one page for me, please?
Would it be possible to print this page?
contexts.feedback: 'Would you mind + -ing' is indirect, so it sounds polite even for a small favour.
contexts.feedbackPersian: Would you mind + -ing غیرمستقیم است، برای همین حتی برای یک خواهش کوچک مؤدبانه به نظر می‌رسد.

contexts.situation: You are on a train. The window next to you is open and it is cold.
contexts.situationPersian: در قطار هستی. پنجرهٔ کنار تو باز است و هوا سرد است.
contexts.goal: Ask the passenger if it is OK to close it.
contexts.goalPersian: از مسافر بپرس بستن آن مشکلی دارد یا نه.
references: Would you mind if I closed the window?
Would you mind closing the window? It is a bit cold.
Do you mind if I close the window?
contexts.feedback: After 'Would you mind if I' use the past simple: closed. With 'mind' + -ing you ask THEM to do it.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از Would you mind if I گذشتهٔ ساده می‌آید: closed. با mind + -ing از طرف مقابل می‌خواهی کاری بکند.

contexts.situation: It is Thursday. You have a doctor appointment at four, but your working day ends at five.
contexts.situationPersian: پنجشنبه است. ساعت چهار نزد پزشک وقت داری اما کار تو ساعت پنج تمام می‌شود.
contexts.goal: Ask your manager for permission to leave early.
contexts.goalPersian: از مدیرت برای زودتر رفتن اجازه بگیر.
references: Would you mind if I left a bit early today?
Would you mind if I left at three thirty? I have a doctor appointment.
Would it be OK if I left early today?
contexts.feedback: For permission, use 'if I' + past simple. Give the reason in a few words.
contexts.feedbackPersian: برای اجازه از if I + گذشتهٔ ساده استفاده کن. دلیل را در چند کلمه بگو.

contexts.situation: Your neighbour is playing loud music at eleven o'clock at night. You have to get up early.
contexts.situationPersian: همسایه‌ات ساعت یازده شب موسیقی بلند گذاشته است. تو باید صبح زود بیدار شوی.
contexts.goal: Ask them nicely to turn it down.
contexts.goalPersian: مؤدبانه از او بخواه صدا را کم کند.
references: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
Would you mind turning it down, please? It is quite late.
Would you mind keeping the music down? I have to get up early.
contexts.feedback: A polite request with a reason is more likely to get a positive answer than an order.
contexts.feedbackPersian: درخواست مؤدبانه همراه با دلیل بیشتر احتمال پاسخ مثبت دارد تا یک دستور.

contexts.situation: Think of a favour you would like to ask someone in your life: a friend, a neighbour or a colleague.
contexts.situationPersian: به خواهشی فکر کن که می‌خواهی از کسی در زندگی‌ات بکنی: دوست، همسایه یا همکار.
contexts.goal: Write a polite request for it.
contexts.goalPersian: برای آن یک درخواست مؤدبانه بنویس.
references: Would you mind watering my plants while I am away next week?
Would you mind giving me a lift to the station on Friday?
contexts.feedback: Use the same pattern for a real favour. Name the action and the time.
contexts.feedbackPersian: همین الگو را برای یک خواهش واقعی به کار ببر. کار و زمان را بگو.

patterns.title: Talking about an effort that is still going on
patterns.titlePersian: صحبت دربارهٔ تلاشی که هنوز ادامه دارد
patterns.frame: I've been trying to … / I've been working on …
patterns.explanation: The present perfect continuous (have been + -ing) shows an effort that started in the past and is still going on: I've been trying to reach you all morning. Use for + a period or since + a starting point.
patterns.explanationPersian: حال کامل استمراری (have been + -ing) تلاشی را نشان می‌دهد که در گذشته شروع شده و هنوز ادامه دارد: I've been trying to reach you all morning. با for + مدت یا since + نقطهٔ شروع به کار می‌رود.
patterns.example: I've been trying to learn ten new words every day.
patterns.examplePersian: مدتی است سعی می‌کنم هر روز ده کلمهٔ جدید یاد بگیرم.

contexts.situation: You have called the bank all morning and nobody answers.
contexts.situationPersian: تمام صبح به بانک زنگ زده‌ای و کسی جواب نمی‌دهد.
contexts.goal: Tell the clerk about your effort.
contexts.goalPersian: به کارمند بگو چه تلاشی کرده‌ای.
references: I've been trying to call you all morning.
I've been trying to reach someone in your department since nine o'clock.
contexts.feedback: Use 'I've been trying to' for an attempt that is still going on.
contexts.feedbackPersian: I've been trying to را برای تلاشی که هنوز ادامه دارد به کار ببر.

contexts.situation: Your online account is locked and you cannot enter it.
contexts.situationPersian: حساب آنلاین تو قفل شده و نمی‌توانی وارد شوی.
contexts.goal: Explain to the support agent what you have tried.
contexts.goalPersian: به مأمور پشتیبانی بگو چه کاری کرده‌ای.
references: I've been trying to log in for an hour, but it doesn't work.
I've been trying to reset my password since this morning.
contexts.feedback: Add 'for + time' or 'since + moment' to show how long.
contexts.feedbackPersian: for + مدت یا since + لحظه اضافه کن تا نشان بدهی چقدر طول کشیده.

contexts.situation: A friend notices that you are drinking more water.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست متوجه می‌شود آب بیشتری می‌نوشی.
contexts.goal: Say what you have been trying to do recently.
contexts.goalPersian: بگو اخیراً چه کاری را سعی می‌کنی انجام بدهی.
references: I've been trying to drink more water.
I've been trying to go to bed earlier.
contexts.feedback: 'Been trying to' fits habits you are still building.
contexts.feedbackPersian: been trying to برای عادت‌هایی است که هنوز در حال ساختنشان هستی.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks why the project is slow.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار می‌پرسد چرا پروژه کند است.
contexts.goal: Explain what you have been working on and for how long.
contexts.goalPersian: توضیح بده روی چه چیزی و چه مدت کار کرده‌ای.
references: I've been working on the data for two weeks, but it is not clean.
I've been trying to fix a bug since Monday.
contexts.feedback: 'Been working on' + noun + 'for / since' explains the delay clearly.
contexts.feedbackPersian: been working on + اسم + for / since تأخیر را روشن توضیح می‌دهد.

contexts.situation: Think of something you have been trying to do or improve recently.
contexts.situationPersian: به چیزی فکر کن که اخیراً سعی کرده‌ای انجام بدهی یا بهتر کنی.
contexts.goal: Write about it in two sentences.
contexts.goalPersian: دربارهٔ آن در دو جمله بنویس.
references: I've been trying to write a short English text every day. I've been doing it since January.
I've been working on my fitness for three months. I've been trying to run twice a week.
contexts.feedback: One sentence for the effort, one for how long or why.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک جمله برای تلاش، یک جمله برای مدت یا دلیل.

patterns.title: Disagreeing politely
patterns.frame: I see your point, but … / I'm afraid I don't agree / I'm not convinced that …
patterns.explanation: Acknowledge the other person first, then give your view: I see your point, but …. Soften a 'no' with I'm afraid I don't agree, or show doubt with I'm not convinced that …. Avoid 'You are wrong'.
patterns.explanationPersian: اول طرف مقابل را تأیید کن، بعد نظرت را بگو: I see your point, but …. «نه» را با I'm afraid I don't agree نرم کن یا تردید را با I'm not convinced that … نشان بده. از «You are wrong» پرهیز کن.
patterns.example: I see your point, but I think we should wait for the data.
patterns.examplePersian: نکتهٔ شما را می‌فهمم، اما فکر می‌کنم باید منتظر داده‌ها بمانیم.

contexts.situation: A colleague suggests finishing the report by tomorrow, but that is not realistic.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار پیشنهاد می‌کند گزارش را تا فردا تمام کنید، اما این واقع‌بینانه نیست.
contexts.goal: Disagree politely and say why.
contexts.goalPersian: مؤدبانه مخالفت کن و دلیلش را بگو.
references: I see your point, but I don't think we can finish by tomorrow.
I'm afraid I don't agree. We need at least two more days.
contexts.feedback: Acknowledge first, then give the reason, not just 'no'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: اول تأیید کن، بعد دلیل را بگو، نه فقط «نه».

contexts.situation: Your friends want to eat at a restaurant that you think is too expensive.
contexts.situationPersian: دوستانت می‌خواهند در رستورانی غذا بخورند که به نظر تو خیلی گران است.
contexts.goal: Politely say you disagree.
contexts.goalPersian: مؤدبانه بگو موافق نیستی.
references: I see your point, but it's a bit expensive for me.
I'm not convinced it's worth the price. Could we try somewhere cheaper?
contexts.feedback: Offer an alternative: it turns disagreement into a plan.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک جایگزین پیشنهاد بده: مخالفت را به یک برنامه تبدیل می‌کند.

contexts.situation: Your manager wants to remove the weekly team meeting, but you think it is useful.
contexts.situationPersian: مدیرت می‌خواهد جلسهٔ هفتگی تیم را حذف کند اما به نظر تو مفید است.
contexts.goal: Disagree and offer an alternative.
contexts.goalPersian: مخالفت کن و یک جایگزین پیشنهاد بده.
references: I see your point, but I think the meeting helps us stay aligned. Could we make it shorter?
I'm afraid I don't agree. What if we reduce it to fifteen minutes?
contexts.feedback: With a manager, use 'I'm afraid I don't agree' and propose a compromise.
contexts.feedbackPersian: با مدیر از I'm afraid I don't agree استفاده کن و یک مصالحه پیشنهاد بده.

contexts.situation: A friend says online courses are always better than classroom courses.
contexts.situationPersian: یک دوست می‌گوید دوره‌های آنلاین همیشه از کلاس‌های حضوری بهترند.
contexts.goal: Respond to the claim with doubt.
contexts.goalPersian: با تردید به این ادعا پاسخ بده.
references: I'm not convinced that's always true. It depends on the person.
That's a fair point, but I think classroom courses have advantages too.
contexts.feedback: 'Not convinced that …' questions a claim without attacking the person.
contexts.feedbackPersian: not convinced that … ادعا را زیر سؤال می‌برد بدون حمله به شخص.

contexts.situation: Think of an opinion you do not share, in a conversation at work or with friends.
contexts.situationPersian: به نظری فکر کن که با آن موافق نیستی، در یک گفتگوی کاری یا دوستانه.
contexts.goal: Write how you would disagree politely.
contexts.goalPersian: بنویس چطور مؤدبانه مخالفت می‌کردی.
references: I see your point, but I think remote work is not for everyone. It depends on the job.
I'm not convinced that longer meetings are better. I think shorter ones keep people focused.
contexts.feedback: Acknowledge, disagree, give one reason.
contexts.feedbackPersian: تأیید کن، مخالفت کن، یک دلیل بگو.

patterns.title: Making an offer with a condition
patterns.frame: … provided that … / … as long as … / We'd be willing to …
patterns.explanation: To make a conditional offer, state what you can give and the condition: We can offer a discount, provided that you pay today. As long as and on condition that mean the same. After them use the present simple (no will).
patterns.explanationPersian: برای پیشنهاد مشروط بگو چه چیزی می‌دهی و شرطش چیست: We can offer a discount, provided that you pay today. as long as و on condition that هم‌معنی‌اند. بعد از آن‌ها حال ساده می‌آید (بدون will).
patterns.example: We'll agree as long as the delivery is on time.
patterns.examplePersian: قبول می‌کنیم به شرط آن‌که تحویل به موقع باشد.

contexts.situation: A client asks you to finish a website in one week. You can do it if they send the texts today.
contexts.situationPersian: مشتری می‌خواهد وب‌سایت را در یک هفته تمام کنی. اگر امروز متن‌ها را بفرستد می‌توانی.
contexts.goal: Agree, but state your condition.
contexts.goalPersian: قبول کن اما شرطت را بگو.
references: I can finish it in a week, provided that you send me the texts today.
I can do it as long as you send the texts by tonight.
contexts.feedback: Give the offer first, then the condition after 'provided that / as long as'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: اول پیشنهاد را بگو، بعد شرط را بعد از provided that / as long as بیاور.

contexts.situation: You want to rent a flat. The landlord asks for a higher price.
contexts.situationPersian: می‌خواهی آپارتمانی اجاره کنی. صاحبخانه قیمت بیشتری می‌خواهد.
contexts.goal: Offer to pay more only if something changes.
contexts.goalPersian: پیشنهاد بده فقط در صورت تغییر چیزی بیشتر بپردازی.
references: I'd be willing to pay more, as long as you include the internet.
We'd be willing to pay a bit more, provided that the contract is for two years.
contexts.feedback: After 'as long as' use the present simple: 'you include', not 'you will include'.
contexts.feedbackPersian: بعد از as long as حال ساده بیاور: you include، نه you will include.

contexts.situation: A supplier wants a quick payment. You need a discount in return.
contexts.situationPersian: یک تأمین‌کننده پرداخت سریع می‌خواهد. تو در عوض تخفیف می‌خواهی.
contexts.goal: Offer quick payment with a condition.
contexts.goalPersian: پرداخت سریع را با یک شرط پیشنهاد بده.
references: We can pay within seven days, provided that you give us a five percent discount.
We'd be willing to pay in a week, as long as the price is lower.
contexts.feedback: In negotiation, every offer has a condition: give something, ask for something.
contexts.feedbackPersian: در مذاکره هر پیشنهاد شرطی دارد: چیزی بده، چیزی بخواه.

contexts.situation: A colleague asks you to cover their shift on Saturday.
contexts.situationPersian: یک همکار از تو می‌خواهد شنبه جای او شیفت بگذاری.
contexts.goal: Agree, but ask for something in return.
contexts.goalPersian: قبول کن اما در عوض چیزی بخواه.
references: I can cover your shift, as long as you take mine next week.
Sure, provided that you take my Sunday shift.
contexts.feedback: A friendly condition keeps things fair.
contexts.feedbackPersian: یک شرط دوستانه همه چیز را منصفانه نگه می‌دارد.

contexts.situation: Think of something you would agree to do, but only under a condition.
contexts.situationPersian: به چیزی فکر کن که قبول می‌کنی انجام بدهی اما فقط با یک شرط.
contexts.goal: Write your offer with the condition.
contexts.goalPersian: پیشنهادت را با شرط بنویس.
references: I'd be happy to work on Saturdays, provided that I can take a day off during the week.
I'll take the project, as long as I can choose my own team.
contexts.feedback: Offer + condition: one sentence is enough.
contexts.feedbackPersian: پیشنهاد + شرط: یک جمله کافی است.
